name: Satish's AI Content & Chat Assistant
author: satish

sections.description:
Gemini API WooCommerce & Content Assistant (now Satish’s AI Assistant) is a powerful AI-driven tool that brings Google’s latest Gemini 2.5 Flash model directly into your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features:
* AI Post Optimization: Transform messy post content into perfectly formatted HTML with a single click.
* WooCommerce Ready: Optimize product descriptions for better conversion and sales copy.
* Smart Chat Search: Add an AI-powered search assistant to your frontend using a simple shortcode [gemini_chat_search].
* Premium Aesthetics: Clean and modern chat interface that matches any premium theme.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > AI Assistant Settings to enter your API key.
  4. Use the AI Optimizer box in the post/product editor or add [gemini_chat_search] to any page.
sections.faq:
How do I get a Gemini API Key?

Visit Google AI Studio, log in with your Google account, and click “Create API Key”.

Is it free?

Yes, Google Gemini offers a generous free tier for developers.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with Post Optimization and Chat Search.
  • WooCommerce product support.
